Directions: Use the information to answer each question that follows.
Content: A student was outside during recess and noticed leaves falling from a tree. The student wondered why the leaves fell down. Their teacher decided to have the students conduct their own experiments to observe for themselves how gravity affects objects. A group of students did an experiment using paperclips and a ruler. `text(First)`, the students tied metal paper clips to a metal ruler using a string. The drawing shows what happened when the students tilted the ruler.
